主要内容: The report highlights key developments by major life insurance companies in the U.S. on December 2, 2013. MetLife, Inc. (MET) saw its stock decline by 0.25% on November 27, 2013, with a 0.47% drop over three trading days, compared to the Dow Jones Industrial Average's 0.20% rise. Prudential Financial, Inc. (PRU) announced a $324 million financing deal with Q-Park, securing 13 parking facilities in the Netherlands. The loan has a five-year term, predominantly fixed rate, and marks Prudential's second mortgage loan in continental Europe since 2012. Lincoln National Corp. (LNC) saw its stock rise 1.18% on November 27, 2013, with a 2.10% increase over three trading days, outperforming the S&P 500's 0.14% rise. Genworth Financial Inc. (GNW) recognized its CEO, Thomas J. McInerney, as part of Fortune's "Top 50 Business People," noting his 124% profit increase for the first nine months of 2013. Torchmark Corp. (TMK) was also mentioned but no specific details were provided.
